presentation.label: Hair loss
presentation.free_text_prompt: Tell us about your symptoms and when they started. You may want to tell us if you have noticed patchy hair loss or general hair thinning, any itching, pain or rash and how long it's been going on for.
pre_form_information: If you are feeling very unwell, seek urgent medical help.

questions.question: Have you noticed increased hair shedding or thinning recently?
Is the hair loss affecting specific patches rather than the whole scalp?
Have you noticed redness, itching, or scaling of the scalp?
